name: status-line
description: A status line under the prompt: the folder and branch with its pull request, model and effort, and bars for context and the five-hour, weekly and Fable limits.

githubAccount.title: GitHub account
githubAccount.description: The gh account the pull request is looked up as (its token from `gh auth token --user`). Empty uses whichever account gh has active, or GH_TOKEN.
